mock_design_notes: With 180 class items and 12 skills (~15–16 each), guided 15-item sets can skill-balance with low session reuse.
Difficulty mix remains mostly 2–3 with several 4s — suitable for mid-level class mocks.
Continue lotes toward ~200; Lote 8 (final) should top up remaining gaps to ~16–17 per skill (see blueprint).

batches.notes: Batch 1 toward ~200 class items. Preferred filling skills that had 3 in the original 40 (Prepositions, Conjunctions/Transitions, Pronouns, Conditionals, Passive Voice, Comparatives/Superlatives, Articles/Determiners, Modals) at 2 each, plus 2 Word Forms and 2 Verb Tenses. All 20 passed rubric on first self-score (avg>=4.0, no dim<3). No near-duplicates vs intro or bank stems.

Batch 2 toward ~200 class items. Prioritized Subject-Verb Agreement (3) and Gerunds/Infinitives (3) which were still at 4 after Lote 1; plus Word Forms 2, Verb Tenses 2, Prepositions 2, Modals 2, and 1 each of Conjunctions/Transitions, Pronouns, Conditionals, Passive Voice, Comparatives/Superlatives, Articles/Determiners. Difficulty mix 9×d2, 7×d3, 4×d4. All 20 passed rubric on first self-score (avg>=4.0, no dim<3). No near-duplicates vs intro or bank stems.

Batch 3 toward ~200 class items. Prioritized bank80 lows (all at 6): Conjunctions/Transitions 3, Pronouns 3, Conditionals 3, Passive Voice 3, Comparatives/Superlatives 3, Articles/Determiners 3, plus Prepositions 1 and Modals 1. Difficulty mix 8×d2, 8×d3, 4×d4. One rewrite during authoring (0102 distractors: removed bare 'were' which formed a second valid past passive with 'serviced'). All 20 passed rubric (avg>=4.0, no dim<3). No near-duplicates vs intro or bank stems.

Batch 4 toward ~200 class items. Prioritized bank100 lows: Subject-Verb Agreement 4 and Gerunds/Infinitives 4 (both were 7); then Word Forms 2, Verb Tenses 2, Prepositions 2, Modals 2, plus 1 each of Conjunctions/Transitions, Pronouns, Conditionals, Passive Voice. Difficulty mix 7×d2, 9×d3, 4×d4. All 20 passed rubric on first self-score (avg>=4.0, no dim<3). No near-duplicates vs intro or bank stems.

Batch 5 toward ~200 class items. Prioritized bank120 lows: Comparatives/Superlatives 4 and Articles/Determiners 4 (both were 9); then Word Forms 2, Verb Tenses 2, Prepositions 2, plus 1 each of Conjunctions/Transitions, Pronouns, Conditionals, Passive Voice, Modals, Subject-Verb Agreement. Difficulty mix 7×d2, 9×d3, 4×d4. All 20 passed rubric on first self-score (avg>=4.0, no dim<3). No near-duplicates vs intro or bank stems.

Batch 6 toward ~200 class items. Prioritized bank140 lows (all at 11): Conjunctions/Transitions 3, Pronouns 3, Conditionals 3, Passive Voice 3, Gerunds/Infinitives 3, Modals 3; plus Prepositions 1 and Subject-Verb Agreement 1. Difficulty mix 7×d2, 9×d3, 4×d4. One stem rewritten during authoring (0159 kept first+present-perfect instead of mixed near-duplicate of 0129). All 20 passed rubric (avg>=4.0, no dim<3). No near-duplicates vs intro or bank stems.

Batch 7 toward ~200 class items. Prioritized bank160 lows: Word Forms 4, Verb Tenses 4; then Prepositions 3, Subject-Verb Agreement 3, Comparatives/Superlatives 3, Articles/Determiners 3. Difficulty mix 6×d2, 10×d3, 4×d4. One distractor rewritten during authoring (0188: replaced defendable "one" with "these"). All 20 passed rubric (avg>=4.0, no dim<3).
